metadata.method: Serial workers, 60s group deadline including startup, at least 200ms warmup per size, five batches of at least 20ms with 16-call time checks and no iteration cap, GC before batches. Render reuses a prebuilt AST. CPU includes all process threads. RSS is cumulative peak.
